ops.body:
Done 2026-08-31. forge-studio is converged: app **12.22.5**, `helper v12.22.5 ok=True`, both agents status 0 with live PIDs, socket present at `~/.daemonkit/a/com.yasyf.captain-hook.host.v1/daemon.sock`, 137 hooks enumerated, and a fresh headless session produced a populated heartbeat ledger.

The uv-cache trap was real and hit again: `uv tool install --force 'capt-hook==12.22.5'` failed with "no version of capt-hook==12.22.5" until `uv cache clean capt-hook`, exactly as on the workstation.

## The convergence blocker was NOT the drain bug

Runbook `68af1c77` records "never reach for `package-install` as a repair — that is what wedged forge-studio". Three attempts today show the actual mechanism, and it is different and better-behaved.

Each failure was `deploy`'s **inventory gate refusing because a live process held the deployment's executables** — the gate working exactly as designed:

    package-install exit 1: captain package: land delivered app: deploy: live processes remain on
    the deployment's executables: pid 42254 .../Captain Hook.app/Contents/PlugIns/CaptainHookWidget.appex/...

    package-install exit 1: ... live processes remain on the deployment's executables:
    pid 52252 .../Captain Hook.app/Contents/Helpers/capt-hookd

Attempt 1 was blocked by the **Notification Center widget extension** (`CaptainHookWidget.appex`) — launched by macOS's extension host, not by daemonkit, so quiesce does not manage it, but `requireEmpty` correctly counts it. Attempt 2, after killing the widget, was blocked by a transient `capt-hookd run --event PreToolUse` dispatch: that host was actively serving sessions. Attempt 3 succeeded once the agents were already booted out and nothing held the bundle.

**Both intermediate failures left the host down and were recovered in one command each** (`launchctl kickstart -k gui/$UID/com.yasyf.captain-hook.host.v1` plus a plain kickstart of the helper), exactly as the runbook promises. After attempt 2 the LaunchAgents were unregistered entirely (`Could not find service … in domain`), and `capt-hook helper install` re-registered them.

**12.22.5's honesty is what made this legible.** Every failed attempt printed

    Error: Homebrew holds 12.22.5 but the running helper reports no version (unreachable) —
    the deployment did not converge.

and exited 1. The pre-12.22.5 code would have printed "Captain Hook installed" and exited 0 on the same state.

**Practical guidance for the next convergence on a busy host:** quit the Notification Center widget first, and expect a transient hook dispatch to lose one attempt. The retry is safe.

Residual, unrelated: `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.yasyf.captain-hook.host.v1.plist.bak-20260828-010739` is stale leftover cruft on that host.
